name: genlayer-milestone-oracle-app
description: Wallet-based web client for the Milestone Oracle Intelligent Contract on GenLayer Studionet

scripts.build: esbuild web/src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/app.js && esbuild web/src/builder.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/builder.js && esbuild web/src/card.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/card.js && esbuild web/src/deployfactory.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/deploy-factory.js && esbuild web/src/probe.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/probe.js && esbuild web/src/landing.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/landing.js && esbuild web/src/diagnose.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=web/diagnose.js
scripts.test: node tests/browser/wallet_flow.test.mjs && node tests/browser/pages.test.mjs && node tests/browser/correctness.test.mjs
